title: Just Juice Berry Burst & Lemonade Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: For a limited time only, you can enjoy two of Just Juice’s most popular flavours in a perfectly blended fusion of Berry Burst and Lemonade. The luxuriously sweet flavour of strawberries, blueberries and raspberries are tumbled into zingy, refreshing lemonade for an exclusive e-liquid that will linger long on the taste buds and memory. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
